content: The provided text appears to be a detailed medical form or template for documenting HIV-related patient information, including testing, diagnosis, treatment, and other clinical data. The patient's National Identification Number, ANC/PMTCT Number, and Clinic Number are required for record-keeping purposes. Additionally, the Soundex of the Surname and any Other Unique Identifiers should be documented to ensure accurate identification. HIV Testing and Diagnosis The First HIV Rapid Antibody Test was conducted on [MM/DD/YYYY]. The result was either Positive, Negative, or Indeterminate. A p24 Antigen Test was performed on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results indicating either Positive or Negative. A Second (Confirmatory) HIV Rapid Antibody Test was conducted on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results recorded as Positive, Negative, or Indeterminate. An RNA Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) Test was performed on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results documented as Positive or Negative. A Third HIV Rapid Antibody Test was conducted on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results noted as Positive or Negative. A Proviral DNA Test was performed on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results recorded as Positive or Negative. An HIV Serological Antibody Test (ELISA/EIA) was conducted on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results documented as Positive or Negative. An HIV Culture Test was performed on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results noted as Positive or Negative. An HIV Indirect Fluorescent Antibody Test was conducted on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results recorded as Positive or Negative. The HIV Recent Infection Testing Algorithm was applied on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results indicating either Recent or Longstanding infection. An HIV Western Blot Test was performed on [MM/DD/YYYY], with results documented as Positive or Negative. The Date of the Last Negative HIV Test (if applicable) was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY], along with the Place of the Last Negative HIV Test. HIV Care and Treatment The Date of First Enrollment in HIV Care was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. If the patient was Transferred In from another facility, this was noted as Yes, No, or Unknown. The Transfer In Date was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY], and the Name of the Previous Facility was documented. The Date Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) was Initiated was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. If the patient was on ART at the previous clinic, this was noted as Yes, No, or Unknown. Co-trimoxazole Dispensed was documented as Yes or No, with the Date of First Dispensation recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. If the patient is part of a Discordant Couple, this was noted as Yes or No. Antiretroviral (ARV) Therapy The Date of Initiation of First-Line Therapy was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY], along with the specific Regimen used. If the patient was switched to a second-line regimen, the Date of Switch was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY], along with the new Regimen. Tuberculosis (TB) Status If the patient was diagnosed with Tuberculosis, this was noted as Yes. The Date of TB Diagnosis was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. If the patient received TB Treatment, this was documented as Yes or No, with the Date of Treatment Initiation recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. WHO Staging If the patient was diagnosed with WHO Stage III, this was noted as Yes, with the Date of Diagnosis recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. If the patient was diagnosed with WHO Stage IV, this was noted as Yes, with the Date of Diagnosis recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. Maternal History (For Female Patients Only) If the patient is Currently Pregnant, this was documented as Yes or No. Information about the patient’s Live-Born Infants was recorded, including: Child’s Name (if known). Child’s Date of Birth (if known), recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. Place of Birth (including the name and address of the hospital). Additional Laboratory Results The First CD4 T-Cell Count and Percentage were recorded as [cells/µL] and [%], respectively, with the Date of Collection noted as [MM/DD/YYYY]. The Source of Data was identified as either Laboratory Record or Medical Record/HIV Patient Card. The Most Recent CD4 T-Cell Count and Percentage (if not the first test) were recorded similarly. The First Viral Load Test was documented, with results indicating either Detectable (copies/µL and log value) or Undetectable. The Date of Collection was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. The Most Recent Viral Load Test (if not the first test) was documented in the same manner. Probable Route of Transmission The probable route(s) of HIV transmission were identified, including: Sexual contact with males or females (Yes, No, or Unknown). Injection of non-prescription drugs (Yes, No, or Unknown). Receipt of blood or blood product transfusion or transplant (Yes, No, or Unknown). If the probable route was Heterosexual Contact, further details were documented, such as: Contact with an HIV-infected person (unknown risk). Contact with a person who injects drugs. Contact with a bisexual male. Contact with a sex worker or client of a sex worker. Transfer Out and Death The Date of Transfer was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY], along with the Name and Location of the Facility the patient was transferred to. The Date of Loss to Follow-Up was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. The Date of Death was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY], with the Cause of Death noted as either HIV-Related or Non-HIV-Related. The Place of Death was also documented. Ministry of Health Use Only The Date Received was recorded as [MM/DD/YYYY]. The Type of Report was identified as either a New Case or Follow-Up Information/Sentinel Events for a Previously Reported Case. Additional comments were included, emphasizing that countries should adapt the form to their specific needs, including demographic characteristics, transmission risk categories, and facility types.
